q: 1994 ruling made secularism basic, floor test compulsory, revival possible after mala fide dismissal. Which?
expl: Bommai 1994 curbed 356 misuse; floor test, review, secularism basic.
why: Bommai is lead authority on President Rule limits. Others deal with detention, environment, harassment.

q: Panel advised 356 as last resort after warning, later cited as prudence without binding force. Which?
expl: Sarkaria urged restraint, warning, last resort for President Rule.
why: Sarkaria is advisory prudence. Bommai later gave binding teeth to similar restraint.

q: Proclamation on irrelevant ground reviewable though satisfaction subjective. Doctrine?
options: Limited review of satisfaction per Bommai
No court can examine at all
expl: Bommai allows test for mala fide, irrelevant grounds, floor breach.
why: Satisfaction is not wholly immune. Courts check relevance without replacing policy wisdom.

q: AP saw central rule in instability and bifurcation debates. Lesson?
options: Shows why Bommai floor test matters
expl: AP history shows misuse risk; hence floor test and review.
why: AP episodes show political use of breakdown power. Bommai discipline applies fully to AP.

q: AP Governor move to dismiss without floor majority test sparked row. Correct law?
options: Majority proved on House floor not Raj Bhavan
expl: Bommai-Sarkaria: floor decides majority, Governor only reports.
why: Raj Bhavan estimate cannot replace floor test. Governor invites test, not decides numbers.

q: LS Secretariat gets 1/10th notice to disapprove emergency. Duty?
expl: 44th mandates special LS sitting in 14 days on 1/10th notice.
why: This is parliamentary check on executive. Ignoring violates mandatory procedure.

q: Cabinet oral nod at midnight, proclamation next morning. Fate?
options: Invalid for want of written advice
expl: 44th needs written Cabinet advice; oral nod invalid.
why: Form prevents personal rule. Without writing, proclamation lacks foundation.

q: Claim: financial emergency has same 3-year cap as state emergency. Flaw?
expl: 360 has no 3-year cap; approved in 2 months then extended.
why: Borrowing 356 cap for 360 is exception trap. Each tenure logic is distinct.

q: Mock says Bommai held President Rule non-justiciable and secularism not basic. Error?
options: Inverts ratio; reviewable and secularism basic
expl: Bommai held secularism basic, 356 reviewable, floor test must.
why: Mock inverts ratio to trap memory. Correct Bommai expands review and revives assembly.

q: Link written advice plus war ground plus LS revoke plus life immunity. Synthesis?
options: Valid war needs writing, LS can revoke, 20-21 survive
Valid war ends all, LS helpless
expl: Procedure, ground effect, revocation, immunity operate together.
why: War freezes 19 but not 20-21. Written advice and simple-majority disapproval remain checks.
